headline: Lululemon (LULU) Faces California Lawsuit Over Alleged Misleading Discount Prices
summary: Lululemon athletica (NasdaqGS:LULU) is facing a consumer lawsuit in California that challenges its use of reference prices on discounted items. The complaint alleges that Lululemon used former prices that did not reflect actual recent selling prices, creating the appearance of larger discounts. The case adds to broader legal scrutiny of how major retailers communicate pricing and promotions to shoppers. Lululemon athletica has built its brand around premium athletic and leisure apparel,...

headline: Tariff refund drives Q2 profit at Delta Galil
summary: Activewear maker Delta Galil has reported an increase in Q2 profit, lifted by tariff refunds, a portion of which it will invest in its manufacturing and supply chain to drive future growth.
